notes.title: Ember's Journal 7: Busy times!!!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/2cdd35a932b4c62e29fc249ed6f9d08550e92e8c.png"][/img][/p][p]Our wishlists are currently sitting at just below 3,300 - we are still feeling good from the [url="https://www.alphabetagamer.com/end-of-ember-prototype-download/"]Alpha Beta Gamer review[/url] and video (see below), and we're hoping that lots of cool activity in the next couple of months should boost that a little further.[/p][p]This should put us roughly on track for the 7-10K wishlists any game needs to rise above the massive saturation of Steam. Of course the sky's the limit and we really hope to smash this minimum, but for now every wishlist counts so thank you if you have already wishlisted and encouraged others to do so.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="o1PDj6sy3TA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/bed48eaeb8f3ea75d007c7e2aec3e0dd7ec56319.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are so excited to announce the results of our EmberxAVCon Fan Art competition. First prize was this amazing clay polymer sculpture by [url="https://www.instagram.com/shanebevin/"]Shane Bevin[/url]:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="t0qZKNxNhjU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Everyone who saw it loved this entry so much - from the medium to the sense of action and gore that is just so Ember, it was a standout.[/p][p]Second prize went to [url="https://www.instagram.com/skye_j.r_scholes/?e=73c6ab91-f380-4dea-a377-aaf32202684f&g=5"]Skye[/url], who went to the effort of painting an Ember triptych in oils:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/e6b51735a96ce7abd3be7c2930039bd4199cbd69.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We loved the effort and time put into this one to work with the media.[/p][p]There were so many other great entries, so Dishonourable mentions go to [url="https://mechanisedconvulsions.bandcamp.com/album/escape-from-adelayed"]Mechanised Convulsions[/url] for a [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AUldgemDjmU"]rad music track[/url], old mate Townsey for [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QNe3ssRvc8E"]End of Emgame[/url], Miss Cherrybomb (with not just [url="https://www.instagram.com/p/DL384klJ8Qv/?igsh=MXZ6dnZtZzJzazN5NA%3D%3D"]one[/url], but [url="https://www.instagram.com/p/DMNCHK1p7g1/"]two [/url]and [url="https://www.instagram.com/p/DL4JLKkpOAa/"]three [/url]entries), and one of our all time favourites [url="https://x.com/Chetohhh/status/1941080105792721313"]Cheetoh[/url].[/p][p]Thanks to everyone for their entries: we loved the creativity and energy and are so grateful for everyone's input. We'll be posting all these to our socials and as you might know, we love including them in the game as well. [/p][p]Long live fan art![/p][p]Finally, we are so excited to be featured in the [url="https://www.youtube.com/@theindiebrew"]ANZ Indie Showcase[/url] and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ANZIndieFest2025"]Indiefest[/url], starting on the 5th of September! Check us out along with 47 other amazing games from Australia and New Zealand.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/ecb002d74d237c27868e8ebfaa3bf1279f5d1742.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/a20f4e947d26335139cdf054d9d6e6cc68f74918.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We had been hoping to get our Demo (full beta build) out on Steam by the end of October, but sadly realised that just wasn't achievable (indie lyfe, yo). So we are currently planning to try and define a new demo release date, and we think that will be in early 2026, so stay tuned![/p][p]At the moment we are driving towards out PAX Build, which will not only be playable live at [url="https://aus.paxsite.com/"]PAX Australia [/url](10th-12th October, 2025) - we will of course make this build available via Steam. we are committed to making the most current version of the game available to everyone all the time so no-one misses out.[/p][p]In the meantime you can always play End of Ember via Steam Playtest: just go to our store page and mash the Playtest button:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/4460883fdc1d34011c8c4f8c84bb1bb28aefc5b9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Why not invite a Steam friend to check it out while you're there?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/238772ea3a0051e408021648491ba1e14b7ad329.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to the [url="https://www.safilm.com.au/latest-news/south-australian-video-game-talent-to-showcase-to-the-world-as-the-safcs-sage-sa-game-exhibition-goes-global-at-gamescom-2025/"]SAFC[/url], Chad and Dan attended the Trade floor at GamesCom in August, which was a great opportunity to meet publishers, platform representatives, and generally bring Ember to the world. Plus the hotdogs were great.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/bf8f8177eb0385de68cd39e372062159874bebc2.png"][/img][/p][p]Bad Plan is kicking along as always, but we are also excited to announce that we have grown our team slightly: welcome to Adam and Matt who are joining us as Technical Director and Programmer, respectively. They joined us on the booth at AVCon and they are helping Eli with all the gnarly programming stuff that works under the hood of the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/e4152ad69cfa609e4afa31070929eacd77d9145b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With our core team in place we are excited for what's to come! Thanks for following along and seeya next time.[/p][p]Luv[/p][p]Dan, Eli, Chad, Adam and Matt[/p][p]xo[/p]

notes.title: AVCon 2025 Fan Art Competition
notes.content:
[h1]Overview[/h1][p]Update: Due to a hectic AVCon and Smash event this weekend, this competition's end dat ehas been extended until 5pm on Friday, the 18th of July.[/p][p]To celebrate the coming together of so many communities at AVCon 2025, Bad Plan Studios is running a Fan Art Competition (with prizes!) to see who can best capture and interpret the hellish world of Ember. While we are promoting the competition during the event, you don't have to be attending AVCon to enter, but you do need to be over 18.[/p][h1]             [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/db145ddd244e9c9cca3e6e3ebd038f7ac6c478fd.png"][/img]       [b]X[/b]         [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/bb03b391f5f809a90b5b4657aa31fe7959036523.png"][/img][/h1][h1]Major Prizes[/h1][h2]First Prize: People's Choice[/h2][p]$250 cash (transferred by EFT/PayPal), because Cash is King! This People's Choice prize will be given to the piece of art that achieves the most traction on the Steam Competition page and across other socials. (See below '4.3 Engagement Calculation' for how votes will be measured.) To be in the running for this you need to share and promote your entry across as many social channels as you can (and tag us, of course, for extra reach).[/p][h2]Second Prize: Jury Selection[/h2][p]A $250 Coles Myer voucher. This 'Jury Selection' prize will be chosen by Bad Plan Studios (and let's face it, Dan will have double voting rights). We will be looking for a balance of individual expression and respecting the course, quality, and a bold kind of vision.[/p][h2]Third Prize: Design A Boss[/h2][p]For this category we encourage the community to do their best to design a new boss that might be included in the game. Tag it with #BossConcept, and make it conceptual rather than polished. Use arrows, callouts and labels to suggest how parts might be detailed or how they might contribute to gameplay. Take inspiration form the Fetid Larvae Wet Nurse in the game or form @eyerophant's enemy concept:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/126416b7b2b7cddae5e7d756e15560d1dec1c915.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The prize for Design a Boss is an opportunity to spend 1-2 hours with the Bad Plan dev team ideating and working up your concept for consideration for inclusion into the game. If your ideas are used, you will be given a credit in the game. (We reserve the right to select no winners, or to select multiple winners.)[/p][h1]Runner Up Prizes[/h1][h2]Dishonourable Mentions (x3 or maybe more): Just Cool Stuff[/h2][p]An End of Ember t-shirt for 3+ entries that didn't quite make it for first or second, but we still thought were really cool. You can wear your tee-trophy with pride for the rest of your life.[/p][h2]Sponsored Prizes[/h2][p]Thanks to our amazing sponsors we have some Runner-Up Prizes to offer:[/p][olist][*][p][url="https://greenlightcomics.com/"]Greenlight Comics[/url]: (prize TBC);[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.blackmatchcandles.com.au/"]Black Match Candles[/url]: An Oblivion candle;[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.rundlemall.com/stores-and-services/vicious-video"]Vicious Video[/url]: copy of [i]Igor and the Lunatics[/i];[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://adultblisserotica.com.au/?srsltid=AfmBOoq17PJTnHB5hVR-5E5_7lii4_8eXMlz8Rau7Qb2Z0Cvcia9UpHb"]Adult Bliss Erotica[/url]: $200 Voucher (After Dark category)[/p][/*][*][p]Palace Nova Cinemas: double pass to any film[/p][/*][/olist][h1]How to Enter[/h1][p]To enter this competition, simply:[/p][olist][*][p]View 'Inspiration' below, play End of Ember, or peruse our social media posts or [url="https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1-1B3pc5NZQ2d1ByqG4Xm1SrILxICgjZZ"]Presskit [/url]to get ideas;[/p][/*][*][p]Draw cool stuff! [b](Please ensure you include your handle/name on the image itself!)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Post your entry to one of your social media accounts and then post the link to the Steam Community page for the AVCon 2025 Fan Art Competition (this helps to keep all the entries in one place)[/p][/*][*][p]\[For the Peoples' Choice Award]: Post to all your socials, tag @endofember and @teamavcon, and encourage your friends to like, comment, and share.[/p][/*][*][p]\[For the Peoples' Choice Award]: Direct people to your Steam entry post to support it, because all engagement there is weighted x3 for counting.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h1]Inspiration and Creative Guidelines[/h1][p]Let's face it, as an art-led game, End of Ember is pretty clear about its vibe. It's cute but gory, over the top, and it turns heads. That's what we are looking for in our Fan Art. It can be anything plausibly inspired by the game: an image of Ember, enemies (already existing or concepts!), environments, weapons, props, or anything that is clearly located in the world of the game.[/p][p]At the same time, no-one can draw like Dan, so we really encourage you to take your own interpretation of the art style and do your own thing with it. Wanna try Ember as a magical girl (or boy) with stacks of glitter and a halo? Go for it. Super-kawaii anime stylings? Bring it on. Surrealist/Cubist appropriations of interwar counter cultural philosophies? Brilliant! Hentai? Probably not - check the Terms and Conditions below. (NSFW is fine.)[/p][p]If you need some inspiration, check out what our wonderful community has already come up with! (note: previous fan artists [b]are eligible[/b] to submit their work for this competition).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/2dd932f9c8796e9cc503858b7153746a3a2e8825.jpg"][/img]       [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/cd3b015c89b2de6c19c9baf4ecbea28b53731bbe.png"][/img]       [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/31d3b945ef1e21cb637aab9d64a55b8c884f9944.png"][/img]       [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/64abd96294afa8d3d950389281f0834e22a55eea.png"][/img]       [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/7584d7d3ebbcf85a5fc598180a2d8abb7d1e9d89.png"][/img][/p][p]  [url="https://www.instagram.com/mangaxai/"]@mangaxai[/url]           [url="https://x.com/Ty_AlexanderArt"]@ty_alexanderArt[/url]          [url="https://x.com/Chetohhh"]@cheetohhh[/url]    [url="https://www.youtube.com/@AtlasAgainstTheUniverse."]@atlasagainsttheuniverse[/url]   [url="https://www.instagram.com/yayanpradityasw/"]@yayanpradityasw[/url] [/p][h1]Terms and Conditions[/h1][h2](Legal Stuff: Boring But Important!)[/h2][h3]Fan Art Competition Terms and Conditions[/h3][p][/p][p][u]1. Competition Overview[/u][/p][p][b]Competition Name:[/b] End of Ember AVCon 2025 Fan Art Competition
[b]Event Association:[/b] [url="https://www.avcon.org.au/"]AVCon 2025[/url] 
[b]Competition Period:[/b] 9am Monday 30th June to 5pm Friday 18th of July [/p][p][b]Organizer:[/b] Chad Habel, Bad Plan Studios: [url="mailto:badplanstudios@gmail.com"]badplanstudios@gmail.com[/url]; Team AVCon[/p][p][/p][p][u]2. Eligibility[/u][/p][p]2.1. The competition is open to participants worldwide, [b]aged 18 and above[/b].[/p][p]2.2. Attendance at the associated physical event (AVCon 2025) is NOT required for participation.[/p][p]2.3. Employees, contractors, and immediate family members of the organizer are not eligible to participate.[/p][p]2.4. Each participant may submit a maximum of 3 entries. Each entry will be judged separately.[/p][p][/p][p][u]3. Submission Requirements[/u][/p][p]3.1. [b]Submission Platform:[/b] All entries must be submitted to at least one online platform to be eligible for a prize. It is [b]strongly recommended[/b] that you submit your entry (social medai link) to the Competition/Event page on Steam and encourage others to like and comment as it will ensure visibility for the judges and vastly improve your chances of winning the Peoples' Choice Award.[/p][p]3.2. [b]Content Requirements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Original fan art only (no traced, copied, or AI-generated artwork);[/p][/*][*][p]Must relate to End of Ember: main character, NPCs/enemies (in-game or concepts), environments, weapons, props, bosses etc.;[/p][/*][*][p]Suitable for all audiences (no explicit, offensive, or inappropriate content; NSFW is OK for the After Dark category);[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum file size: as per platform requirements;[/p][/*][*][p]Accepted formats: as per platform requirements;[/p][/*][/list][p]3.3. [b]Submission Details:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Submission must be made to at least one digital platform, and may also be made to multiple social media accounts;[/p][/*][*][p]Include competition hashtags: @endofember; @TeamAVCon_ (and invite us to collaborate on Instagram for extra exposure!) and #BossConcept for the Design a Boss category;[/p][/*][*][p]Include Sponsor profile tags to be eligible for sponsored prizes;[/p][/*][*][p]Provide a brief description of the artwork in comments/description (including alt description);[/p][/*][*][p]Include artist's username/handle on the art itself;[/p][/*][*][p]Submission must be public and visible.[/p][/*][/list][p]3.4. By submitting, participants confirm they are the original creator and own all rights to the artwork.[/p][p][/p][p][u]4. Judging and Awards[/u][/p][p]4.1. [b]People's Choice Award:[/b] Determined by the highest combined engagement (likes, comments, and shares) across social media platforms subscribed to by End of Ember where the artwork is shared. For list of these, please visit: [url="https://linktr.ee/endofember"]https://linktr.ee/endofember[/url][/p][p]4.2 Jury Selection and Design a Boss to be judged by Bad Plan Studios Development Team; Sponsored Prizes to be selected by sponsors;[/p][p]4.3 Judges' decision is final and no correspondence will be entered into;[/p][p]4.4. [b]Judging Period:[/b] 5pm Friday 18th July - 5pm Friday 25th July[/p][p]4.5. [b]Engagement Calculation:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each like = 1 point (x3 for Steam)[/p][/*][*][p]Each comment = 2 points (x3 for Steam)[/p][/*][*][p]Each share = 3 points (bonus 9 points if you share the Steam competition page)[/p][/*][*][p]Total cumulative engagement across all applicable platforms will be counted at time of judging. See [url="https://linktr.ee/endofember"]https://linktr.ee/endofember[/url] for included platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]NB: while you are encouraged to invite organisers and sponsors to repost or collaborate on your posts (Instagram), their doing so is at their discretion based on their assessment of the artwork and their availability or interest in doing so. [/p][/*][/list][p]4.6. [b]Winner Announcement:[/b] before 5pm Monday, 14th July.[/p][p]4.7. [b]Prizes:[/b] [/p][p]4.7.1 [u]People's Choice Award[/u]: $250 cash prize transferred by EFT/PayPal[/p][p]4.7.2 [u]July Selection[/u]: $250 Coles Myer Voucher[/p][p]4.7.3 [u]Design a Boss[/u]: a 1-2 hour ideation session with the Bad Plan Development team (in person or online); if your ideas are incorporated into the game, you will be given a credit for your contribution (nb: we reserve the right to award no prizes in the category, or to award multiple prozes;[/p][p]4.7.4 [u]Dishonourable Mention: [/u]End of Ember t-shirt (minimum 3)[/p][p]4.7.5 Sponsored Prizes (TBC): prizes sponsored by Greenlight Comics, Black Match Candles, Vicious Video, Adult Bliss Erotica etc.[/p][p]4.8. [b]Prize Collection:[/b] All prizes can be collected from a pre-defined location in the Adelaide CBD, or posted at the entrant's expense. [/p][p][/p][p][u]5. Intellectual Property and Rights[/u][/p][p]5.1. Participants retain ownership of their original artwork.[/p][p]5.2. By entering, participants grant the organizers a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to:[/p][list][*][p]Display the artwork in connection with the competition and associated event;[/p][/*][*][p]Use the artwork for promotional purposes related to the competition;[/p][/*][*][p]Share the artwork on organizers' social media channels with proper attribution;[/p][/*][*][p]Integrate the artwork into the final game with proper attribution.[/p][/*][/list][p]5.3. Participants must not infringe on existing copyrights, trademarks, or intellectual property rights (adaptations, references, and reinterpretations of End of Ember are allowed and even encouraged!).[/p][p]5.4. Fan art must comply with fair use principles and applicable copyright laws.[/p][p][/p][p][u]6. Content Guidelines[/u][/p][p]6.1. Submissions must be appropriate for all audiences.[/p][p]6.2. Prohibited content includes:[/p][list][*][p]Explicit sexual content (NSFW is fine for the After Dark category);[/p][/*][*][p]Hate speech or discriminatory content;[/p][/*][*][p]Content that violates platform, organizer or event community guidelines;[/p][/*][*][p]Spam or commercial advertisements.[/p][/*][/list][p]6.3. The organizer reserves the right to disqualify any entry that violates these or other applicable guidelines, policy and legislation, or any contribution that in their reasonable opinion, is inappropriate.[/p][p][/p][p][u]7. Disqualification[/u][/p][p]Entries may be disqualified for:[/p][list][*][p]Violation of submission requirements;[/p][/*][*][p]Inappropriate content;[/p][/*][*][p]Evidence of vote manipulation or artificial engagement;[/p][/*][*][p]False information provided during submission;[/p][/*][*][p]Violation of Steam Community or other platform/event guidelines.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u]8. Privacy and Data Protection[/u][/p][p]8.1. Personal information collected will only be used for competition administration and winner notification.[/p][p]8.2. Winners may be required to provide additional information for prize fulfillment.[/p][p]8.3. The organizer will not share personal information with third parties without consent.[/p][p][/p][p][u]9. General Terms[/u][/p][p]9.1. [b]No Purchase Necessary:[/b] Entry is free and no purchase is required.[/p][p]9.2. [b]Technical Issues:[/b] The organizer is not responsible for technical failures, lost submissions, or platform outages.[/p][p]9.3. [b]Modification Rights:[/b] The organizer reserves the right to modify these terms with reasonable notice.[/p][p]9.4. [b]Winner Verification:[/b] Winners may be required to verify their identity and eligibility.[/p][p]9.5. [b]Tax Responsibility:[/b] Winners are responsible for any applicable taxes on prizes.[/p][p]9.6. [b]Force Majeure:[/b] The organizers are not liable for delays or cancellations due to circumstances beyond reasonable control.[/p][p][/p][p][u]10. Limitation of Liability[/u][/p][p]10.1. Participation is at the participant's own risk.[/p][p]10.2. The organizer is not liable for any damages arising from participation in the competition.[/p][p]10.3. Prize fulfillment is subject to availability and may be substituted with items of equal value.[/p][p][/p][p][u]11. Governing Law[/u][/p][p]These terms and conditions are governed by South Australian law.[/p][p][/p][p][u]12. Contact Information[/u][/p][p]For questions regarding the competition, contact:
[b]Email:[/b] [url="mailto:badplanstudios@gmail.com"]badplanstudios@gmail.com[/url]
[b]Website:[/b] [url="https://badplanstudios.wordpress.com/"]https://badplanstudios.wordpress.com/[/url]
[b]Social Media:[/b] [url="https://linktr.ee/endofember"]https://linktr.ee/endofember[/url][/p][p][/p][h1]Tagging Guidelines[/h1][p]To be eligible for the maximum number of prizes, post to as many platforms as possible using the following tags (don't forget to use #BossConcept for the Design a Boss category):[/p][p]Steam: #emberXavcon (remember you get 3x points for all engagement on the Steam Event page!)[/p][p]Instagram: #emberXavcon; @end_of_ember; @teamavcon; @vicious_video; @blackmatchcandles; @adultbliss.au; @greenlightcomics[/p][p]X/Twitter: #emberXavcon; @end_of_ember; @TeamAVCon_; @greenlightkomix;[/p][p]Bluesky: #emberxavcon; @endofember.bsky.social‬; ‪@avcon.bsky.social‬; [/p][p]Facebook: #emberXavcon; @End Of Ember; @Team AVCon; @Black Match Candles; @Greenlight Comics;[/p][p]TikTok: #emberXavcon; @end_of_ember; @Team_AVCon; @greenlightcomics; @vicious.video[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]By participating in this competition, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these terms and conditions.[/b][/p][p][i]Last updated: 9th July, 2025[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Ember's Journal 6: Amazing News
notes.content: [p]Welcome to our June Edition of Ember's journal, in which we are so excited! If you're in Adelaide, come play our most recent game build and meet at at [url="https://www.avcon.org.au/"]AVCon: July 5th-6th, Adelaide Showground[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/ac0e87d266b32b252d4e730822c06fb5116f60d7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/2cdd35a932b4c62e29fc249ed6f9d08550e92e8c.png"][/img][/p][p]Off the back of a few showcases, events and some incredible [url="https://www.youtube.com/redirect?event=video_description&redir_token=QUFFLUhqbkR2REpTam0ybG01dTE5Q1VPeVVBb2loU01uUXxBQ3Jtc0trc1lsNTE0eFNwNkFOZ0pXcHhXQWpVVDhndEdYRWlzc0xJZ09UTEYzblBMWkp5UGF5Q0dyUGxiSkRKbEs4cGNwcEJBZml3Wm5ZcjJRU2pXTmpWSUdDeUFWcXgxVjlTS2JydkNoekpPbXNmNTd3Z21pMA&q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.alphabetagamer.com%2Fend-of-ember-prototype-download%2F&v=o1PDj6sy3TA"]AlphaBetaGamer coverage[/url] ('highly recommended', yewwww!), our [b]wishlists experienced their first spike[/b], really ever:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/081d83da42ec3e50071a2aa75a9a5252329eacd2.png"][/img][/p][p]Off the back of this we have [b]just cracked 3K Wishlists![/b] Thanks everyone for their support and encouragement, it's been so great as we can now see a path towards our visibility goals for demo and full release.[/p][p]Also huge shoutouts to [url="https://youtu.be/VW1y34J_v8M?si=hFbV4f3P8jUvp5iD"]The Horror Games Awards Summer Showcase[/url], [url="https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw?si=ES2PoZXVwyPwamzA&t=2996"]Frosty Games Fest[/url], and [url="https://youtu.be/_e06C1_o6jA?si=sEq8zBh-adBIh_Qb&t=941"]Games to Get Excited About[/url] for including us, as well as all the streamers and VTubers who have shown off the game. We are really feeling the love, thank you so much.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/bed48eaeb8f3ea75d007c7e2aec3e0dd7ec56319.png"][/img][/p][p]We seem to have reached a tipping point where others are into the game enough that they are posting on our behalf, which is kind of a dream come true. Really this all started with AlphaBetaGamer, whose playthrough video got [b]13K views and heaps of comments[/b]:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="o1PDj6sy3TA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]They followed up by including in their showcase and have said multiple times that they love the game, so we are hoping for some good coverage when we have demo keys available.[/p][p]On that - if you're a content creator interested in collaborating with us, please hit us up on any of our socials or [url="mailto:badplanstudios@gmail.com"]email us[/url] as we'd love to work with you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/a20f4e947d26335139cdf054d9d6e6cc68f74918.png"][/img][/p][p]Of course, with all this going on at the surface level, development continues unabated as the dev team have been working on our 'AVCon 2.0' build. (Because it's the second time we've done AVCon. Phewf, has it been a year already?!) [/p][p]Dan has added a lot to the tutorial/introduction section, and Eli has been implementing a new projectile system, AI system, and doing so many other Magical Cave Wizard things we can't keep up.[/p][p]Important point: we will be shifting our build updates to be [b]playable on Steam[/b] from now on, so the Itch version will just remain static (or we might pull it). This isn't a full release or even a demo or early access, it's just part of a gradual shift to more community playtesting and more activity on Steam.[/p][p]Related, we are now recruiting for playtesters! This is all run through our Discord community so please [url="https://discord.gg/8edZeSEsxt"]join us there[/url] and react to the call for playtesters: [url="https://discord.com/channels/1140902154152968222/1243376218666172457/1382908541819682866"]Discord call for playtesters[/url].[/p][p]After all this, if you haven't seen our new trailer yet, check it out:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="-svLLtnNNM0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/238772ea3a0051e408021648491ba1e14b7ad329.png"][/img][/p][p]While the core Bad Plan team (Dan, Eli Chad) have been pulling together, we have realised there is a lot more work on the technical side than we originally thought. So, we have asked for help from Adam Schmidt (Technical Consultant) and Matthew Pannell (Programmer) to help make the game as robust as possible on the technical side. Thanks folks![/p][p]In sum, things are looking good for Ember! This has been a major breakthrough that has really encouraged us that people are into what we are making. Thanks to you all for your support so far, and keep making noise![/p][p]Love yas,[/p][p]Dan, Eli, Chad, and Ember[/p][p]xx[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/a190caf28063cd76e76eacfc8cc4fddb6e0f3b98.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Ember's Journal 5: Studio Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/2cdd35a932b4c62e29fc249ed6f9d08550e92e8c.png[/img]

Wishlists for End of Ember are tracking slowly but surely, and we are now at 653. We got a nice little spike around SAGE which tells us that doing events and activations like that are good, so we've got some big news coming up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/bed48eaeb8f3ea75d007c7e2aec3e0dd7ec56319.png[/img]

Super exciting news! End of Ember will be featured in both the[url=https://www.frostygamesfest.com/] Frosty Games Fest [/url](June 8th, 2025) and the[url=https://www.youtube.com/@HorrorGameAwards] Horror Games Awards Showcase [/url]in Summer (May 31st) and Halloween. We will have new, never-before-seen trailers showing at both these events so check them out and support the events that support us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/1b7c58ef954a9ca2c8a33d2e3089f75c022f75c1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/f635a75ed034c50415f6582b4f3a4c16bfe225d8.png[/img]

We've been posting fairly consistently across all our socials with a big focus on short form content: we love showing current developments, so check out this throwback introducing us back in the day :

[previewyoutube=jrmgTeQxoF4;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't forget to follow us on any of the platforms to stay up to date!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/a20f4e947d26335139cdf054d9d6e6cc68f74918.png[/img]

Dan and Eli have been working real hard on the game to get a new build ready for [url=https://www.avcon.org.au/]AVCon: Adelaide's anime and gaming festival[/url] in early July. It's mostly another iteration of the project rebuild, but players will certainly see some new content, including a few new rooms and some more introductory stages which explains what happens when Ember first gets to Hell.

Of course, for folks not in Adelaide, we will update the build on our Itch page, but this is probably the last open update we will make until we launch the full demo on Steam. We hope to have an announcement on that date soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/238772ea3a0051e408021648491ba1e14b7ad329.png[/img]

Bad Plan is rocking along as usual - we are looking to bring to some new folks in to help with the technical aside of the game development. Stay tuned for announcements!

Chad, Dan and Eli
xo

notes.title: Ember's Journal 4: SAGE Post-Mortem
notes.content:
Hello community - and wow, it’s hard to believe that it’s been four months since we launched our Steam page! Our big news this time is that we have just presented End of Ember at the South Australian Games Exhibiton ([url=https://www.sagameexhibition.com/]SAGE[/url]), the premier event for SA gamers and studios. It was rad!

We were so lucky to be in the company of many talented and hardworking studios. Check out all the great games that were on show (and skip to 1:13 for the obvious best one!):

[previewyoutube=MedhIB-9zxE;full][/previewyoutube]

One of the most exciting things was being featured in a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/SAGE2025?l=english]Steam sale for the event[/url], check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/2cdd35a932b4c62e29fc249ed6f9d08550e92e8c.png[/img]

Our Steam wishlist count smashed through the 500 mark over SAGE (we are now at 563!) - thanks to everyone who has shown us support in this way! Even better, we hear via the excellent folks at [url=https://gamediscover.co/]GameDiscoverCo[/url] that the game's 'hype score' has almost doubled (to a still-modest 21, haha) in the past week, meaning that there is some kind of action happening for us on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/bed48eaeb8f3ea75d007c7e2aec3e0dd7ec56319.png[/img]

Bluesky continues to be a great place for us to hang out, connect with other folks in the gamedev and gaming community, and share info and updates on the state of the game. We are now SO CLOSE to 1000 followers, and if you haven’t checked it out yet we recommend you join up to see what it’s like to curate your own algorithm and actually see what is being posted by people you followed. [url=https://bsky.app/profile/endofember.bsky.social]Come party like it’s Twitter in 2012.[/url]

[url=https://bsky.app/profile/endofember.bsky.social][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/85cac4bdf4e7ba107a7a732f4396682b00d190c1.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/a20f4e947d26335139cdf054d9d6e6cc68f74918.png[/img]

This is the big one for us this time: our SAGE build is the first time we have shown this new Unity project to the public. We are ambitious about the experience and level of quality we want to deliver to players, and Dan and Eli worked really hard to make the game as good as it could be. Most people really enjoyed it, and we were quite encouraged by some compliments from senior industry figures too. One player summed up the experience very well: 'It's disgusting. I love it!'

While it sure was great to have IRL players enjoy the game we know that not everyone could make it there, so we are pleased to make the build available via Itch.io: 

[url=https://badplanstudios.itch.io/end-of-ember]Play End of Ember for free on Itch![/url]

[url=https://badplanstudios.itch.io/end-of-ember][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/4da4faf2a95a6d00c5d73ae7de638c07e0b43b9e.png[/img][/url]

We are now working on a few refinements to the current state of the game before building in the hub world and beginning to design and build the 'digging gameplay', the second main loop of the game where Ember uses her chainsaw to dig her way out of Hell. Stay tuned to any of our socials (scroll to the bottom for links) as we share what we are working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/238772ea3a0051e408021648491ba1e14b7ad329.png[/img]

Bad Plan Studios is still just running along like a deranged three-legged dog. SAGE was a great opportunity to hang out together, celebrate the game, and share it with others. We are now extra motivated and are looking towards showcasing at AVCon and maybe even PAX Australia and South by Southwest Sydney! 

Overall we had a great time at SAGE and thanks to everyone for coming and playing End of Ember. Check us out at the booth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/194ce31d4d176ac06e91461718c9bd2163a27890.jpg[/img]

That's it for this one, ciao for now!

Chad, Dan, and Eli
xx

notes.title: Embers Journal 3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/1e897cd24d06d6c6f979f7916ccde74177f93c4a.png[/img]

Happy New Year, Emberites! Here’s hoping you had a bit of a break and some good times with family and/or friends towards the end of the year and you’re facing 2025 with renewed energy and vigour. End of Ember is kicking along and we’ve got some exciting updates to share with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/2cdd35a932b4c62e29fc249ed6f9d08550e92e8c.png[/img]

Our wishlists are now tracking at 481 - thanks to everyone who has added the game! We really appreciate that support and it keeps us going. We are hoping to have a few big events this year which will get us some spikes to track us towards our Wishlist goal for release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/bed48eaeb8f3ea75d007c7e2aec3e0dd7ec56319.png[/img]

Probably the biggest news is that we have had huge growth in Bluesky - we are now looking at 888 followers! IYKYK: Bluesky is like old-school social media, something like Twitter in 2012. There is no punishing algorithm, you can really curate your own feed, and in general there is a strong vibe of community and positivity. So if you’re looking for a good social media experience, check it out! (Protip: Google ‘Bluesky Starter Pack’ + whatever you’re into - video games, cycling, underwater basket weaving - and you’ll get kicked off with a curated list of cool accounts to follow.)

Our best performing post this month was a throwback to the introduction devlog for Eli: he’s just the best, and makes everything in the game work. Love ya guts, E!

https://www.youtube.com/embed/l5KVn8YQsVk?si=tuzj2yMqbSGovr7I

As always, you can join us on any of our socials (links at the bottom of this page).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/a20f4e947d26335139cdf054d9d6e6cc68f74918.png[/img]

We are SO EXCITED at our current development: we’re just inches away from our current production goal, which is to replicate the AVCon build we had in June, but in the new project. As of today we are about 90% of the way towards completing the full game loop: that’s the intro/tutorial, a cutscene to take us into the main game, all the rooms, shop and Mutator, obviously all the enemies and upgrades, and the boss.

You can keep track of where we are at by following us on any of our socials, and you won’t miss gold like gore updates!

For those who won’t be able to make it to SAGE in February, we plan to share the build via Steam or Itch so you can still be part of the fun. We’ll also have some competitions and giveaways that will be designed to include folks online, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/5add9c33eb06da5267ee60d3c2ce5fc08f28bc22.png[/img]

If you're not local to Adelaide, stay tuned to hear about playtesting, competitions and other stuff we have planned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/238772ea3a0051e408021648491ba1e14b7ad329.png[/img]

Due to the holiday season we have been a bit up and down as some of us have had some much-needed rest. But perhaps the most exciting development is that we took delivery of the shirts Dan designed! We love them a lot and so does the community - almost all of the first run were snapped up through pre-orders, so we hope to do another run for SAGE. If you want in, hit us up with your shirt size at badplanstudios@gmail.com.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/4368191e2fa4d62bc3bbefc79cdaa5f83e9f3b31.jpg[/img]

That’s it for this one - don’t forget to like, comment and share this to help feed that algo.

Thanks for reading and catchya soon!

Love
Chad, Dan and Eli

notes.title: Embers Journal 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/1e897cd24d06d6c6f979f7916ccde74177f93c4a.png[/img]

Hey, and welcome to our second monthly community update! It’s been a huge month since the launch of our Steam page: wishlists are coming in, the game is developing nicely, and we are planning for a game convention to show off our new build!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/2cdd35a932b4c62e29fc249ed6f9d08550e92e8c.png[/img]

As always, we want to be totally transparent and let the community know how we are going with our Wishlists. After our launch we came out of the gate pretty strong but as expected things have slowed down since then. Our current number of Wishlists sits at 397. We are still ahead when tracking against our long-term goal of 7K Wishlists by launch but that lead will run out soon (eek!), so we are hoping we make it up with upcoming events and future developments.

Thanks for everyone who has wishlisted End of Ember and supported us in other ways on social media and so on. Love ya guts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/bed48eaeb8f3ea75d007c7e2aec3e0dd7ec56319.png[/img]

First up, when we launched our Steam Page we also launched our Gameplay Trailer, made by Dan with amazing music by Nathan (https://www.nathancummins.com.au/). Check it out! 

[previewyoutube=8AZEjOGR-B4;full][/previewyoutube]

If you know us personally, you might have heard that we had a fairly gnarly time on our Steam launch page in terms of some posting we did on Reddit. In short, we got banned and had a whole bunch of people saying some pretty nasty stuff. It was a big learning experience and we talked about it in more detail on a devlog: 

[previewyoutube=UUYj2GI0o-w;full][/previewyoutube]

Another update this month is that we joined the #xodus and started an account on Bluesky. We hope this will be another great way to develop a community around the game and get word out. If you are a fellow Blueskyer, join us there: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/b9d0eb936f0dd2e0d8838d4a8c756db4633aad60.png[/img]

As always, you can join us on any of our socials (links at the bottom of this page).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/a20f4e947d26335139cdf054d9d6e6cc68f74918.png[/img]

Production is buzzing along. Eli is away for a bit (see below) but he did amazing work before he left so Dan has plenty of work to do engineside. He is currently building all the rooms, adding enemies, and implementing all the systems that Eli has built.

But yeah, we are making great progress on our ‘new project’ - same game, same art, but all new code to build systems properly from scratch. We hope that in a month or two we have a build which is pretty much the same content-wise as our janky alpha prototype (https://badplanstudios.itch.io/end-of-ember), but with fewer major bugs and softlocking errors. The great news is that the project will be in a good place to build out all the other systems we have planned and especially 20 million rooms Dan has in mind.

Our current target is to have the new project build ready for the South Australian Game Exhibition: https://www.safilm.com.au/latest-news/applications-for-sage-2025/ If you’re in Adelaide, put 7-8 February 2025 in your Calendars and come along to the special mature-rated section of the Exhibition to play End of Ember!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/bf61f27aa487b3689b90747013ab547899010540.png[/img]

If you're not local, stay tuned to hear about playtesting, competitions and other stuff we have planned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/238772ea3a0051e408021648491ba1e14b7ad329.png[/img]

Big news for Eli - he got married on November 16th, 2024! YEEEWWWWWWW! Congratulations to Eli and Crystal. Chad and Dan were so excited to help celebrate the wedding (check the photo for a special guest), and right now Eli is off enjoying his honeymoon in North America. Say hi to Tay Tay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/a190caf28063cd76e76eacfc8cc4fddb6e0f3b98.jpg[/img]

That’s it for this one - don’t forget to like, comment and share this to help feed that algo.

Thanks for reading and catchya soon!

Love
Chad, Dan and Eli

notes.title: Embers Journal 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/1e897cd24d06d6c6f979f7916ccde74177f93c4a.png[/img]

Welcome to the first entry in Ember’s journal, our monthly devlog for updates about all things Ember and Bad Plan. If you like what you see or have any questions please leave a comment below as we’d love to hear from you - it really keeps us going!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/2cdd35a932b4c62e29fc249ed6f9d08550e92e8c.png[/img]

Since we just launched our Steam page we don’t have anything for you now, but in the interest of transparency we aim to provide updates on just how many wishlists we have gathered each month. If you don’t know, wishlists are super important for indie games as they show the audience’s interest. Not only do they help us predict possible sales on release, they can be great material to get interest from publishers, investors, and grant funding bodies. We will also share data on the game’s ‘hype’ on Steam, according to the (excellent) GameDiscoverCo hype chart. All of this is just to let you know how things are tracking for the game: our goal is 7K wishlists for release, and thanks for helping us get there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/bed48eaeb8f3ea75d007c7e2aec3e0dd7ec56319.png[/img]

Here will update you on happenings across all our socials, including YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, TikTok, Reddit, itch.io and Game Jolt. We started most of these only a few months ago so they are still growing, but we hope for it to be a great place to reach a wider audience and community. If you want to join us on any of these sites scroll down and click through on any of the links. 

Throughout October we are posting a fun series on YouTube shorts where we unboxed a horror-themed advent calendar; you can check it out from the first entry: [previewyoutube=9hLR3rbTd4o;full]https://youtube.com/shorts/9hLR3rbTd4o?feature=share [/previewyoutube]

Our first Announcement Trailer has been tracking well on YouTube, with nearly 5K views; 84 likes (96.6 likes vs. dislikes) and 33 comments. If you haven’t caught it yet, here it is:

[previewyoutube=tBQH6OAE0Cw;full]https://youtu.be/tBQH6OAE0Cw [/previewyoutube]

And we love our our full Gameplay Trailer which we launched with the Steam page too:

[previewyoutube=8AZEjOGR-B4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/a20f4e947d26335139cdf054d9d6e6cc68f74918.png[/img]

If you’re not across the development of the game, Dan started it about 12 months ago all on his own, and taught himself everything he needed to know to get the prototype running (which you can play at https://badplanstudios.itch.io/end-of-ember). Problem was, he’s not a trained programmer, so we were left with a pretty bad case of spaghetti code. He got Eli in to help him and they worked together to finalise the build for AVCon at the end of June. Chad then came along to help with production and business stuff and they formed Bad Plan Studios in June 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/d3fd1e56a2d94903d47f988b7b2760fc452113d1.jpg[/img]

After AVCon, Eli started getting PTSD and a pretty bad twitch in his eye when we suggested working on the prototype, so we shelved it and started an entirely new project. This felt like a big step backward (especially for Dan, lol) but it was necessary to ensure the code base had a proper architecture and Eli understood how everything was done, and then it could be scaled up to include the whole vision that Dan has in mind. So we are still working towards the goal of having the new project at the same content level as the prototype, but we are hoping to be there some time in the beginning of next year. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/238772ea3a0051e408021648491ba1e14b7ad329.png[/img]

Not much to report here: Dan and Chad attended Melbourne International Games week in October and had a great time mingling with other industry folks and playing games at PAX. Eli has been busy building a pool, celebrating his Buck’s weekend in Melbourne, and preparing for his wedding in November. And we’ve all been doing the Dadly thing, caring for the little crotch goblins.

Thanks for reading, peace out and see you at the next one!

Love
Chad, Dan and Eli
